title: Research: binary execution of the selected head-offset callback
body:
PR2405 leaves native numerical arithmetic and loop bounds at its selected head-ADD site. I replace that complete callback with binary word arithmetic: raw fields through 64-dimensional projector preparation, the 128-dimensional Pair table, generated indices/weights and the final modular offset. I also consume the encoded coefficient in a complete ADD and inverse using binary counters.

The proof gives arithmetic and continuation invariants, owned-scratch erasure and the local uniform charge. Under the retained root coupling, the callback fits the conservative `A_q w^1800` allowance and the complete ADD costs `C_q V`. I keep the selected frontier unchanged.

Verification covers:

- Actual COPY510 and nonidentity owner MOVE sources; 20,480 projector entries, 277 table entries and pinned raw fixtures. Dense high fields exercise the full matrix path.
- Nine generated callback cases, including a numerical Pair reversal, two reset forms and root extent `2^600`. Runtime operands stay encoded; the checker blocks native word inspection.
- Complete 15,552-bit payload origins, inverse restoration, arithmetic/counter checks and fourteen semantic rejection controls with input preservation and scratch audits.

The package registers Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays, with source authentication and a deterministic receipt. I ran both locally with CPython 3.12.13 on macOS arm64. I have not run a new Lean build, selected cold replay or independent human review.

This is an executable finite-alphabet word machine with written all-length arguments. The full selected residual, recursive child boundary and family/owner/global XOR/COPY/ERASE caller remain open. I claim no new multiplication exponent.

I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4, and refreshed main before submission. The overlap search covered 646 open PRs and 1,175 Discussions with complete pagination. TASK.json records targeted concurrent-work checks and the search limits.

I coordinated this scope in [Discussion2319](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18944524), following the selected-interface handoff in [Discussion2304](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2304). SOURCES.json and NOTICE.md retain exact predecessor pins and credit for source527, PR2159/2160/2188/2234/2310/2332/2364/2405, the selected source contributors and the relative-origin stack lineage. Concurrent PR2386/2399/2420/2426/2439 retain their separate scope.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, checking and writing.
